//: Owned by Recoder. The BUILD tsconfig used by tsup's .d.ts emit. It exists because @recoder/connectors ships multiple entry roots: the foundation (src/index.ts) PLUS the seven typecheck-clean per-channel adapters (telegram/slack/signal/imessage/whatsapp/line/feishu). The package-root tsconfig.json pins rootDir=src and excludes social-gateways/ (raw reference source that does not compile in isolation); declaration emit across the adapter entries therefore needs a config that (a) drops the single src rootDir and (b) includes only the clean adapter subtrees/files alongside src. This is NOT a type-error escape hatch: each adapter already type-checks clean against the foundation via its own scoped tsconfig (social-gateways/<ch>/(connector|adapter)/tsconfig*.json). For telegram/slack/signal/imessage/whatsapp/line the whole connector|adapter subtree is clean and globbed; feishu's clean adapter files live alongside legacy OpenClaw-coupled siblings in the same dir, so only the specific clean files are listed (mirroring feishu/tsconfig.adapter.json). The Discord adapter is excluded: its full connector-port.ts dispatch pipeline still imports the un-extracted OpenClaw bot core (the extracted ../infra leaf cluster is verified separately via social-gateways/infra/tsconfig.json but is not a build entry).
